title: Meta AI Research: Muse Spark, Muse Glimmer and Muse Image
markdown:
# AI RESEARCH

## Our latest AI advancements

### Introducing Muse Glimmer

Open weights and optimized for always-on local agent workflows on consumer hardware.

## RESOURCES

### Muse Image and Muse Video

The first media generation models developed by Meta Superintelligence Labs.

Learn more

### Muse Spark 1.1

Read more about our newest and most capable model and our path to personal superintelligence.

Learn more

### Safety and Preparedness Report

How Muse Spark performs across safety, security, and reliability—and the decisions behind its deployment.

## PERCEPTION

### Segment Anything 3

Our most advanced segmentation model, now with 3D, audio and more capabilities

#### With SAM 3, you can use text and visual prompts to precisely detect, segment and track any object in an image or video.

#### SAM 3D

SAM 3D enables precise reconstruction and analysis of 3D people and objects, providing new opportunities for spatial understanding and applications.

#### SAM Audio

A more conversational Meta Al means you can ask anything, anytime and get helpful answers wherever you are.

## CORE LEARNING & REASONING

### DINOv3

Our most powerful self-supervised algorithm and vision foundation model

#### DINOv3 scales self-supervised learning to train a powerful, more versatile model

### More from Meta's FAIR Team

#### Meta Motivo

A first-of-its-kind behavioral foundation model for embodied humanoid virtual agents.

#### Movie Gen

The most advanced family of media foundation AI models empowering immersive storytelling.

#### Seamless Communication

AI research models that enable more natural, authentic communication across languages.

#### AI Chemistry

Building AI systems solving most important chemistry and material problems for Meta and the world.

Show More

## SAFETY

### Alignment and preparedness

As we chart the path towards superintelligence, AI tools can deeply understand your world and help you get things done faster. With that, reliability, security and user protections are more important than ever.
Read more

#### What is the Advanced AI Scaling Framework?

What is the Advanced AI Scaling Framework?

This framework sets the standards and safeguards we hold our most capable models to — covering how we identify, assess and address the most severe risks before deployment. It's built around comprehensive safeguards, rigorous testing, ongoing research and a level of transparency that goes further than industry norms.

#### What risks does the framework focus on?

What risks does the framework focus on?

The framework is focused on evaluating the most severe areas of potential risks for advanced models including cybersecurity threats, chemical and biological security and safeguarding against loss of control. As we build more agentic AI experiences, we've expanded assessments to evaluate how AI performs with greater autonomy and whether controls around that behavior work as intended.

Core priorities include: comprehensive safeguards, rigorous testing, ongoing research to identify new risks and mitigation techniques.

#### How do you test your models for safety?

How do you test your models for safety?

We stress-test across a wide range of scenarios using automated and human-led evaluations, including adversarial probing. Models are evaluated before and after mitigations are applied to confirm safeguards work in real-world conditions — and only deployed when they meet our framework thresholds.

#### How has your safety approach evolved?

How has your safety approach evolved?

We've moved beyond rules-based systems to teach models why something is safe — not just what is allowed. By translating guidelines across child safety, response quality and handling different viewpoints into testable principles, models can reason through situations rigid rules might never have anticipated.

#### What is a Preparedness Report?

What is a Preparedness Report?

A document covering how each frontier model performs across safety, security, accuracy, helpfulness and user protections. We'll publish one for every frontier model — including risk assessments, evaluation results, methodology, known limitations and deployment reasoning.

## Try experimental demos

### How Meta is applying cutting-edge AI research to real-world interactions.

#### A state-of-the-art, open-source model for video watermarking

Content Seal Video

#### Create video cutouts and effects with a few clicks

SAM 2

## Join us in the pursuit of what’s possible with AI

Open positions
